name: BabyDogeCoin02
fix_description: In swapTokensForEth, set a reasonable amountOutMin instead of 0. Use an oracle or TWAP price to calculate the minimum acceptable output, preventing sandwich attacks that exploit the zero slippage protection.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a long multi-stage chain combining a Pancake V3 flash loan, Venus collateralized borrowing, fee-on-transfer token/liquidity mechanics, and a sandwich-style manipulation across multiple routers and pairs. Writing it requires deep protocol-specific understanding of BabyDoge’s auto-liquidity behavior and careful state setup across several contracts, which is well beyond a straightforward <2 hour exploit.
